# Pomona

> Open-source, local-first edge AI platform for controlled agriculture — greenhouse and hydroponic systems. Pomona combines MQTT sensor ingestion, SQLite persistence, compact specialist reasoners, deterministic safety checks, human-reviewed automation suggestions, and a read-only dashboard. The project is an early alpha (`v0.1.0-alpha.1`), not a production automation product.

Pomona's hard rule: an LLM or reasoner may advise, but it never directly controls hardware. A deterministic safety checker remains the final authority before any actuator or automation action.

Canonical documentation: https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/
Source repository: https://github.com/okyanu/pomona
Hugging Face profile: https://huggingface.co/Okyanus
Live automation API: https://automation-engine-fawn.vercel.app
License: Apache-2.0

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/): project overview, live demo, quickstart, and current capabilities
- [Quickstart](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/GETTING_STARTED/): run Pomona locally
- [Architecture](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/architecture/): system data flow and safety boundary
- [Project status](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/PROJECT_STATUS/): verified current implementation status
- [Roadmap](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/ROADMAP/): planned phases and priorities
- [Model catalog](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/MODEL_CATALOG/): model families, publication status, and safety boundaries

## Try Pomona

- [Guarded browser demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Okyanus/pomona-greenhouse-demo): public greenhouse and hydroponic scenarios, with no installation or login
- [Live automation API](https://automation-engine-fawn.vercel.app): suggestion-only service with interactive API documentation
- [Docker quickstart](https://github.com/okyanu/pomona#-quickstart-any-os--docker): run the local platform stack
- [Example scenarios](https://github.com/okyanu/pomona/tree/main/examples/scenarios): routine, high-risk, missing-data, and stale-data sensor inputs
- [Tomato risk quickstart](https://github.com/okyanu/pomona/blob/main/examples/tomato_risk_quickstart.py): standalone example against a local stack

## Reasoners and safety

- [Tomato risk reasoner](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/TOMATO_RISK_REASONER/)
- [Water and irrigation reasoner](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/WATER_IRRIGATION_RISK_REASONER/)
- [Nutrient, pH, and EC reasoner](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/NUTRIENT_PH_EC_REASONER/)
- [Sensor quality reasoner](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/SENSOR_QUALITY_REASONER/)
- [Safety triage reasoner](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/SAFETY_TRIAGE_REASONER/)
- [Actuator command gate](https://okyanu.github.io/pomona/ACTUATOR_COMMAND_GATE_REASONER/): advisory model output remains subordinate to deterministic checks
